Overview

Athens is a city in Attica with a population of 3,059,764. The historic capital of Greece with ancient ruins, vibrant neighborhoods, and a thriving cultural scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
